notes.title: Entering the public beta!
notes.notes:
Congratulations to all players!
Development has reached the point when our project can be announced to the public.

We will continue to develope it further, but now according to the wishes of the players.

What is available at now:
-3 modes
-9 maps (6 for Battle, 2 for Base Race mode, 1 for Middle Ages mode)
-all weapons are functional
-full support for gamepads
-working customization system

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: New map for Base Race mode!
notes.notes:
Today we released new map for the Base Race mode - Simbirsk for 10 players max.
Instead of carts - players gonna push actual cars through the snow, and at the middle of the map is the railway with heave traffic.

As like in other maps for this mode - crates aren't spawning, ammo adds automatically and all guns are with you from the start.

Good luck, have fun!
